rationale: Current primary-source reports confirm the exact failure class still occurs in 2026 and therefore the route remains topical.
Issue existence is not buyer intent and is not counted as pipeline, revenue, or a successful conversion signal.
Fresh production logs contain crawler traffic only, so changing copy, price, product or route now would destroy the dated acquisition measurement without evidence.

primary_source_evidence.observed_claim: Aborting a stream after function_call can cause a later function_call_output request to fail with 400.
A recent compaction/tool-history report shows continuing Responses API orchestration edge cases.
Tool-call-only turns can skip compaction and grow context until failure.

experiment_gate.pass_condition: At least one nonsynthetic session plus at least one route CTA, or one verified sale.
experiment_gate.failover: If the gate ends with no indexing, nonsynthetic session or sale, stop same-domain page additions and change customer or acquisition channel.
